$note: UNUSED REFERENCE TERMS. The FriendSDK runtime requires a chance-game definition even when a game has no economy actions. Kaldareth never calls buy/play/settle/redeem: its entry fee, split and weekly prize pool are simulated in src/economy/ledger.ts from content/balance.json. This file exists only to satisfy the runtime shape, and no value here is a real payout, an RF price, or a redemption promise. RF amounts are decimal strings in 18-decimal base units. The price and the maximum prize mirror the simulated 500 entry fee and its 250 prize-pool share; the remaining 250 (150 circulation + 100 burn) is never paid out. scripts/check-sdk-boundary.mjs asserts both mirrors and that the game layer never calls the consumable actions.
